name: Browser Tools
description: Guarded agent-browser automation for BotNexus agents

configSchema.description: Absolute path to an existing agent-browser executable. When set it wins over every other resolution step. Supports ${env:VAR} syntax.
Exact agent-browser version used for the managed install directory and for release-asset lookup. Pinned, never a range: the JSON output contract must not move underneath the tools.
When true, allows downloading the pinned agent-browser release asset and verifying its sha256. Disabled by default so no network fetch of an executable happens without an explicit operator decision.
Maximum seconds any single agent-browser command may run before it is abandoned.
Maximum characters of page text returned inline to the model. Text beyond this is spilled to the agent workspace and referenced by path.
